meta.title: Composer typo check
meta.description: Adds a Check button to the composer toolbar: send the current draft to any OpenAI-compatible endpoint and get back only typos (wrong, missing or extra characters and homophone look-alikes), highlighted in the composer and listed in a floating card where each one can be replaced with a click. No rewriting, no style edits. Several sources are tried in order, each with its own system prompt, max_tokens and thinking switch, and every row can be tested from the dialog.
